<span data-as="p">The endpoint should return a JSON response body using the same <a class="link" href="/docs/en/hooks#json-output">output format</a> as command hooks. To block a tool call, return a 2xx response with the appropriate <code>hookSpecificOutput</code> fields. HTTP status codes alone can’t block actions.</span>
<span data-as="p">Header values support environment variable interpolation using <code>$VAR_NAME</code> or <code>${VAR_NAME}</code> syntax. Only variables listed in the <code>allowedEnvVars</code> array are resolved; all other <code>$VAR</code> references remain empty.</span>
<span data-as="p">For full configuration options and response handling, see <a class="link" href="/docs/en/hooks#http-hook-fields">HTTP hooks</a> in the reference.</span>
<h2 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="limitations-and-troubleshooting"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a href="#limitations-and-troubleshooting" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" aria-label="Navigate to header">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 18 18" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5" linecap="round" linejoin="round"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5" linecap="round" linejoin="round"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Limitations and troubleshooting</span></h2>
<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="limitations"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a href="#limitations" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" aria-label="Navigate to header">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 18 18" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5" linecap="round" linejoin="round"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5" linecap="round" linejoin="round"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="min-w-0 break-words cursor-pointer">Limitations</span></h3>
<span data-as="p">Keep these constraints in mind when designing hooks:</span>
<ul>
<li>Command hooks communicate through stdout, stderr, and exit codes only. They can’t trigger <code>/</code> commands or tool calls. Text returned via <code>additionalContext</code> is injected as a system reminder that Claude reads as plain text. HTTP hooks communicate through the response body instead.</li>
<li>Hook timeouts vary by type. Override per hook with the <code>timeout</code> field in seconds.<!-- -->
<ul>
<li><code>command</code>, <code>http</code>, <code>mcp_tool</code>: 10 minutes. Claude Code lowers this default to 30 seconds for <code>UserPromptSubmit</code>, <code>PreModelSwitch</code>, and <code>PostModelSwitch</code> hooks, and to 10 seconds for <code>MessageDisplay</code>.</li>
<li><code>prompt</code>: 30 seconds.</li>
<li><code>agent</code>: 60 seconds.</li>
<li><a class="link" href="/docs/en/hooks#sessionend"><code>SessionEnd</code></a> hooks of any type share a 1.5-second budget. If your settings set a longer per-hook <code>timeout</code>, Claude Code raises the budget to match, up to 60 seconds.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li><code>PostToolUse</code> hooks can’t undo actions since the tool has already executed.</li>
<li><code>PermissionRequest</code> hooks fire when Claude Code is about to ask you for permission.<!-- -->
<ul>
<li>In <a class="link" href="/docs/en/headless">non-interactive mode</a> with the <code>-p</code> flag, that prompt only exists when the Agent SDK’s <a class="link" href="/docs/en/agent-sdk/permissions"><code>canUseTool</code> callback</a> supplies it. In plain <code>-p</code> runs or with <code>--permission-prompt-tool</code>, use <code>PreToolUse</code> hooks for automated permission decisions instead.</li>
<li>Background subagents can’t show a prompt in non-interactive mode. Claude Code still runs the hooks for their tool calls, and if no hook returns a decision, it denies the call. In an interactive session, background subagent prompts surface in your main session and the hooks fire as usual.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li><code>Stop</code> hooks fire whenever Claude finishes responding, not only at task completion. They don’t fire on user interrupts. API errors fire <a class="link" href="/docs/en/hooks#stopfailure">StopFailure</a> instead.</li>
<li>When multiple <code>PreToolUse</code> hooks return <a class="link" href="/docs/en/hooks#pretooluse"><code>updatedInput</code></a> to rewrite a tool’s arguments, the last one to finish takes effect. Since hooks run in parallel, the order is non-deterministic. Avoid having more than one hook modify the same tool’s input.</li>
</ul>
<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="hooks-and-permission-modes"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a href="#hooks-and-permission-modes" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" aria-label="Navigate to header">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 18 18" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5" linecap="round" linejoin="round"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5" linecap="round" linejoin="round"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Hooks and permission modes</span></h3>
<span data-as="p"><code>PreToolUse</code> hooks fire before any permission-mode check, in every <a class="link" href="/docs/en/permission-modes">permission mode</a>, including <code>dontAsk</code>. A hook that returns <code>permissionDecision: &quot;deny&quot;</code> blocks the tool even in <code>bypassPermissions</code> mode or with <code>--dangerously-skip-permissions</code>. This lets you enforce policy that users can’t bypass by changing their permission mode.</span>
<span data-as="p">The reverse is not true: a hook returning <code>&quot;allow&quot;</code> doesn’t bypass deny rules from settings, and it can’t suppress the prompt for MCP tools marked <a class="link" href="/docs/en/mcp#require-approval-for-a-specific-tool"><code>requiresUserInteraction</code></a> or for connector tools <a class="link" href="/docs/en/mcp#organization-controls-on-connector-tools">your organization set to <code>ask</code></a> in sessions where that setting reaches Claude Code. Hooks can tighten restrictions but not loosen them past what permission rules allow.</span>
<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="hook-not-firing"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a href="#hook-not-firing" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" aria-label="Navigate to header">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 18 18" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5" linecap="round" linejoin="round"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5" linecap="round" linejoin="round"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Hook not firing</span></h3>
<span data-as="p">The hook is configured but never executes.</span>
<ul>
<li>Run <code>/hooks</code> and confirm the hook appears under the correct event</li>
<li>Check that the matcher pattern matches the tool name exactly. Matchers are case-sensitive</li>
<li>Verify you’re triggering the right event type: <code>PreToolUse</code> fires before tool execution, <code>PostToolUse</code> fires after. A <code>PermissionRequest</code> hook fires when Claude Code is about to ask you for permission; see the <a href="#limitations" class="link">limitations</a> for the non-interactive cases</li>
</ul>

<li>
<span data-as="p">If you see “jq: command not found”, install <code>jq</code> or use Python/Node.js for JSON parsing</span>
</li>
<li>
<span data-as="p">If the notice shows a JSON validation message, your hook’s stdout parsed as JSON but failed schema validation. If it shows a JSON parse message, the stdout looked like a JSON object but wasn’t valid JSON. Both happen even on exit 0.</span>
<span data-as="p">To fix a parse failure, build the payload with a JSON encoder such as <code>jq</code> instead of string concatenation, so quotes and backslashes inside values are escaped. <span data-as="p">You edited a settings file but the hooks don’t appear in the menu.</span>
<ul>
<li>File edits are normally picked up automatically. If they haven’t appeared after a few seconds, the file watcher may have missed the change: restart your session to force a reload.</li>
<li>Verify your JSON is valid: trailing commas and comments aren’t allowed</li>

<span data-as="p">Your hook prints valid JSON, but the decision doesn’t take effect and no error appears in the transcript.</span>
<span data-as="p">When Claude Code runs a shell-form command hook, one without <code>args</code>, it spawns <code>sh -c</code> on macOS and Linux, Git Bash on Windows, or PowerShell when Git Bash isn’t installed by default. This shell is non-interactive, but Git Bash and some configurations, such as <code>BASH_ENV</code> pointing at <code>~/.bashrc</code>, still source your profile. If that profile contains unconditional <code>echo</code> statements, the output gets prepended to your hook’s JSON:</span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#DCDCAA">  echo</span><span style="color:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#CE9178"> &quot;Shell ready&quot;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#C586C0">fi</span></span>
</code></pre></div></div></div></div><div class="code-block-fade-overlay print:hidden" data-fade-overlay="true" aria-hidden="true" style="--fade-color-light:#ffffff;--fade-color-dark:#0B0C0E"></div></div>
<span data-as="p">The <code>$-</code> variable contains shell flags, and <code>i</code> means interactive. Hooks run in non-interactive shells, so the echo is skipped.</span>
<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="debug-techniques"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a href="#debug-techniques" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" aria-label="Navigate to header">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 18 18" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5" linecap="round" linejoin="round"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5" linecap="round" linejoin="round"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Debug techniques</span></h3>
<span data-as="p">Press <code>Ctrl+O</code> to open the transcript view to check the outcome of a hook run:</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Successful run</strong>: you see nothing, unless the hook’s JSON surfaces something, such as <code>systemMessage</code> or Stop hook feedback.<!-- -->
<ul>
<li>To confirm a hook ran, check for its effect, like a reformatted file, or turn on debug logging as described below and trigger the hook again</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li><strong>Blocking error</strong>: on most events you see the hook’s feedback. When the hook’s JSON made a blocking decision, the feedback is the reason from that decision; otherwise it is the hook’s stderr. On a few events, such as <code>ConfigChange</code> and <code>Elicitation</code>, a block surfaces no message.</li>
<li><strong>Non-blocking error</strong>: the action proceeded, and you see a <code>&lt;hook name&gt; hook error</code> notice with a short explanation, such as the first line of stderr prefixed with <code>Failed with non-blocking status code:</code>, or a JSON validation or parse message.</li>
</ul>
<span data-as="p">Which exit-code and JSON combinations produce each outcome, including the per-event exceptions, is defined in the reference’s <a class="link" href="/docs/en/hooks#exit-code-output">Exit code output</a> section.</span>
<span data-as="p">For full execution details including which hooks matched, their exit codes, stdout, and stderr, read the debug log. Start Claude Code with <code>claude --debug-file /tmp/claude.log</code> to write to a known path, then <code>tail -f /tmp/claude.log</code> in another terminal. If you started without that flag, run <code>/debug</code> mid-session to enable logging and find the log path.</span>
